verdict.rationale: Crawl4AI documents proxy support with authentication and 'automatic retry with proxy chain and fallback fetch function,' plus general 'stealth modes' for bot avoidance, indicating built-in support for routing through proxies. However, there's no explicit documentation of a rotating pool/proxy pool management feature (e.g., automatic IP rotation across a list) — only single proxy connection and retry-on-fail chains are evidenced. Missing for 10: explicit rotating-proxy-pool configuration API, independent hands-on confirmation that rotation avoids blocks in practice.
